subject.title: Agent-to-Agent Communication Tools Have Parameter Conflicts

question: For the remaining `message(action="send")` poll-field conflict, should OpenClaw keep strict rejection of content-bearing poll fields, sanitize/split the schema for send actions, or close this umbrella once https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42820 owns the decision?
rationale: The source-visible remaining behavior is real, but choosing between strict poll intent protection and a more model-forgiving send schema changes the shared message-tool contract across channels.

options.title: Use the narrower canonical issue
options.body: Keep this issue open only as an umbrella until maintainers confirm that https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42820 owns the remaining message-tool decision and close this one afterward.

options.title: Sanitize or split send schema
options.body: Change the message tool so plain sends do not expose or reject poll creation fields unless the caller explicitly chooses `action="poll"`.

options.title: Preserve strict rejection
options.body: Keep rejecting content-bearing poll fields on `send` and document that models must use `action="poll"` when poll content is present.

recommendation.title: Use the narrower canonical issue
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open only as an umbrella until maintainers confirm that https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42820 owns the remaining message-tool decision and close this one afterward.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged sessions work and current agent/outbound file history make this the best routing candidate for the contract decision.
